title: Inversion & Emphasis
completion_message: ¡Brillante! La inversión es una de las estructuras más elegantes y persuasivas del inglés avanzado. Hablar así denota mucha autoridad.

parts.visual: Para darle más impacto y formalidad a una frase (especialmente en discursos o escritos formales), ponemos una palabra negativa al principio e INVERTIMOS el sujeto y el auxiliar (como en una pregunta).
parts.audio: To give more impact and formality to a sentence, especially in speeches or formal writing, we put a negative word at the beginning and INVERT the subject and the auxiliary verb, just like in a question.

parts.visual:
Ejemplos: 
- Normal: We have never seen such a crisis. 
- Inversión: NEVER HAVE WE SEEN such a crisis. 
- Normal: They didn't only win the contract, but they also got a bonus. 
- Inversión: NOT ONLY DID THEY WIN the contract, but they also got a bonus.
parts.audio: Examples. Normal: We have never seen such a crisis. Inversion: Never have we seen such a crisis. Normal: They didn't only win the contract, but they also got a bonus. Inversion: Not only did they win the contract, but they also got a bonus.

parts.visual:
Palabras comunes para inversión: 
- Never (Nunca) 
- Rarely / Seldom (Rara vez) 
- Not only... but also (No solo... sino también) 
- Under no circumstances (Bajo ninguna circunstancia) 
- Hardly / Scarcely (Apenas)
parts.audio: Common words for inversion: Never. Rarely or seldom. Not only, but also. Under no circumstances. Hardly or scarcely.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta de inversión.

questions.question: Never ____ such a terrible presentation! (Nunca he visto).
questions.explanation: Inversión: verbo auxiliar antes del sujeto = have I seen.

questions.question: Not only ____ the budget, but she also finished the project early. (No solo aprobó).
questions.explanation: Inversión en pasado: did + sujeto + verbo base = did she approve.

questions.question: Under no circumstances ____ this confidential information. (Debes compartir).
Rarely ____ such a dedicated employee. (Encontramos - presente).
questions.explanation: Inversión en presente: do/does + sujeto + verbo = do we find.

questions.question: Hardly ____ the meeting when the fire alarm rang. (Apenas había empezado).
questions.explanation: Pasado perfecto invertido: had + sujeto + participio = had the meeting started.

questions.question: Seldom ____ such a high profit margin in this industry. (Se ve - pasiva / uno ve).
Not only ____ brilliant, but he is also a great leader. (Es él).
questions.explanation: Con el verbo to be, simplemente se invierte: is he.

questions.question: No sooner ____ the contract than the client called to cancel. (Habíamos firmado).
Never before ____ such a huge drop in sales. (Ha experimentado la empresa).
On no account ____ to the press. (Deben los empleados hablar).
Only later ____ that he had lied on his resume. (Se dio cuenta ella).
questions.explanation: Pasado simple invertido: did + sujeto + verbo base.

questions.question: Not until yesterday ____ about the new regulations. (Yo supe/Me enteré).
Little ____ about the financial crisis that was coming. (Sabían ellos).
questions.explanation: Little al principio requiere inversión: did + they + know.

questions.question: Not only ____ our target, but we doubled it! (Alcanzamos).
Never in my life ____ so insulted! (He sido).
questions.explanation: Present perfect invertido: have I been.

questions.question: Rarely ____ late for a meeting. (El CEO llega / es).
questions.explanation: Verbo to be invertido: is the CEO.

questions.question: Under no circumstances ____ the building without your ID card. (Puedes entrar).
Scarcely ____ working when the computer crashed. (Había empezado él).
questions.explanation: Past perfect invertido: had he started.

questions.question: Only after the launch ____ how popular the product was. (Comprendimos).
questions.explanation: Pasado simple invertido: did we understand.

questions.question: Not only ____ Spanish, but she also speaks Mandarin. (Habla ella).
questions.explanation: Presente simple invertido: does she speak.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el auxiliar y pronombre correctos para hacer la inversión.

questions.question: Never ____ ____ seen such a mess. (He yo)
Not only ____ ____ sign the deal, but we got a discount. (Hicimos nosotros - pasado)
Rarely ____ ____ make mistakes like this. (Hace él - presente)
Under no circumstances ____ ____ give out the password. (Debes tú - should)
Hardly ____ ____ arrived when the phone rang. (Había ella)
Not only ____ ____ a great boss, but he is a friend. (Es él)
Little ____ ____ know about the problem. (Sabían ellos - pasado)
Only later ____ ____ realize the truth. (Me di cuenta yo - pasado)
Under no circumstances ____ ____ enter this room. (Puedes tú - can)
Never before ____ ____ felt so happy. (Había yo)

pairs.target: Inversión: Not only did she win
